external_reference.departure_reason: The role is a body-frame vertical-velocity penalty (reports/evidence/go2_reward_term_roles_20260917/isaaclab_envs_mdp_rewards.py: torch.square(asset.data.root_lin_vel_b[:, 2])). On this baseline it has now been measured at four walking values. Only the two relaxed points raised the total and moved G3 and G6 together (rough side-step posture falls 59 -> 24 -> 16, push falls 22 -> 10 -> 1 at -2.0 / -1.5 / -1.25), while every counter is non-monotone across all four points. -1.0 extends that observation by the same 0.25 interval to see whether the G3 and G6 gains hold one step further. It is an observation-range extension, not an optimum estimate.
external_reference.literature: R-Sci-4 (Hwangbo 2019) discounts every penalty except the objective term by a curriculum coefficient that starts at 0.3 - lowering one penalty weight is the same direction as that discount. The principle transfers; the number does not (different robot, different dt), and this run applies the smaller weight from iteration 0 rather than annealing it.

single_change.name: lin_vel_z_l2
single_change.applied_by: tools/build_go2_a033_reward_package.py renders the arm ZIP's candidate reward file from the deployed template with this value; the reference copy beside it keeps -2.0 and the two differ in that one line, which the builder checks line by line.

value_derivation.role: Penalize z-axis base linear velocity using an L2 squared kernel (Isaac Lab v2.3.1, reports/evidence/go2_reward_term_roles_20260917/isaaclab_envs_mdp_rewards.py: torch.square(asset.data.root_lin_vel_b[:, 2])). It is the body frame's vertical speed squared - not foot height, not world-frame altitude, not ground clearance. On a slope the body frame tilts with the robot, so the same climb charges differently there than on flat ground.
value_derivation.walk_margin: G-A033 walk margin +0.1359 -> +0.1601 at -1.0 (reports/evidence/go2_reward_mechanism_20260917/PROBES.csv, zone WALK, delta +0.0242, range_status OUT_OF_RANGE - beyond the walking values -2.0, -1.75, -1.5 and -1.25). The stop zone's top is +0.0155. A margin is reward arithmetic over measured postures and is not a ranking basis (reports/GO2_REWARD_MECHANISM_FORECAST.md section 8).
value_derivation.situations: reports/evidence/go2_reward_mechanism_20260917/PROBE_SITUATIONS.csv at -1.0: walk +0.0242, climb +0.0515, sway -0.0940, push -0.0771. At -1.25 the same sheet predicted losses on sway and all four push directions and every one of them came out a gain (reports/evidence/go2_g_a048_readout_20260926/FORECAST_CHECK.csv, 1 of 8 directions right; 11 of 27 cumulative). The cells are carried as a record, not as a prediction this arm relies on.
value_derivation.rule: -1.0 keeps the 0.25 interval of the four measured points (-2.0, -1.75, -1.5, -1.25) and steps once beyond the relaxed end. The interval is an operational choice that keeps the existing spacing; it is not proven more informative than a smaller one. This is G-A037's held value, chosen now on different evidence (see not_claimed).
value_derivation.not_claimed: No score gain is estimated and no improvement is predicted. G-A037 (-1.0) was held for two reasons: its derivation (a smaller vertical-penalty share climbs more) ran against base data section 5 S5, and -1.0 lay outside the single walking value then observed. The second reason has narrowed to one interval beyond the observed range, the same distance G-A048 stepped. The first still holds - 15 cm ge2 was 77 at -1.5 and 24 at -1.25 - so this arm is not chosen by that derivation and its hypothesis does not concern the 15 cm stairs. A failure at -1.0 does not make G-A048's result luck, and a success does not identify its cause.

preregistered.source: fact_rules_v1 with every G-A048 threshold unchanged AND the plan screening edition post_a048_guard_margin_v1 (reports/GO2_GUARD_DESIGN_COMPARISON_20260926.md sections 6-9). Combined locally by tools/verify_go2_basic_motion_harvest.py. There is no server gate. preregistered.threshold_basis: Measured, not intended, and UNCHANGED from G-A048 (and G-A044, G-A043) on purpose for fact_rules_v1 - no adoption threshold moves after any result; the plan screening edition is post_a048_guard_margin_v1, preregistered before this arm. tools/go2_eval_resolution.py (reports/runs/BASELINE_MARGIN.csv delta_resample_sd) gave per-scenario weighted-score standard deviations of G3 1.01823, G4 0.49816, G6 0.43098, G2 0.28229, G7 0.20179, G5 0.02802, G1 0.00000 (/70) and a total-difference sd of 1.26443/70. Each non-flat scenario may lose at most twice its own sd; flat G1/G2 use max_flat_scenario_proxy_drop 2x0.28229/10.5 = 0.054 and max_flat_case_survival_drop 2 robots of 32 - the limit that actually caught G-A043's combined_yaw_right at all three seeds. The group floors and the climbed-robot floors are G-A043's, recomputed from the same stored G-A033 records for the same groups. None of these limits carries training-seed noise: every training in the project used seed 42, so they are lower bounds.

target_group_roles.stairs: the target. Three seeds of the 10 cm case, where the direct A017->A033 comparison (900/900) took the climbed-robot count 28 -> 90 (ge1) and 2 -> 43 (ge2) of 96, and where G-A042 took the ge2 count back to 0. If relaxing the vertical penalty does nothing here, the hypothesis that the penalty charges the rise is not supported at this step size.
target_group_roles.rough: the axis with the largest recoverable deduction (G3 4.22726 of 14.0, survival-1.0 counterfactual 10.71746, reports/GO2_AXIS_BOTTLENECK.md) and the axis this change is predicted to cost through the sway cell. rough_lateral is where a bouncier landing would show first.
target_group_roles.push: the disturbance guard and the second predicted loss. push_pos_x is G6's binding case and it is bound by survival (reports/GO2_AXIS_BOTTLENECK.md). A body allowed to move vertically for less cost may be thrown further by the same shove.

required_records.terrain_level_at_pin: REQUIRED RECORD, NOT A CRITERION: terrain at 700/800/900/999. Curriculum changes may mediate the total effect of the single weight; they do not alone invalidate that comparison. Direct mechanism and generalization remain unresolved; mean terrain is not saturation.
required_records.climb_counts: REQUIRED RECORD AND PLAN SCREENING CRITERION: 10cm and 15cm pooled ge1 and ge2 each >= baseline; at least one of the four strictly increases. Existing fact_rules_v1 guards also apply. tools/go2_climb_count.py; both heights seed101/202/303.
required_records.stairs_forward_distance: REQUIRED RECORD AND PLAN SCREENING CRITERION: for each of stairs_10_down and stairs_15_down, median seed delta of projected_progress_m > 0. Baseline and candidate use the same evaluator/registry and iteration900.
required_records.stall_time_share: REQUIRED RECORD AND PLAN SCREENING CRITERION (plan section 4 item 2). The share of time, before the first termination, in which the commanded-direction projected speed stays under 0.05 m/s for at least one continuous second, with the first 0.5 s and the terminal row excluded; null with a reason when the valid time is zero. Computed by tools/go2_stall_diagnostics.py for both arms with the same rule. The threshold is a design value, not a measured one. Both heights require median seed delta < 0 with simultaneous survival protection.
required_records.first_step_time: REQUIRED RECORD, NOT A CRITERION (plan section 4 item 3). The first timestamp at which the existing >=1 step climb rule fires, per robot, with non-arrivals recorded as null and censored=true. The mean over arrivals may not be reported as an improvement without the arrival rate beside it.
required_records.fall_channel_split: REQUIRED RECORD. The candidate rough_lateral and stairs falls must be split into the height channel and the tilt channel the way tools/go2_a038_reread.py split G-A033's (reports/evidence/go2_a038_reread_20260919/FALL_CHANNEL_ROLLUP.csv). This dial does not charge attitude at all, so a G3 loss is expected to arrive as a base contact rather than as a tilt.
required_records.push_both_directions: REQUIRED RECORD AND PLAN SCREENING CRITERION (plan section 5). For push_pos_x and push_neg_x separately: pooled posture falls over the three seeds must not rise above the baseline, and the per-seed median deltas of survival and tracking proxy must be >= 0. This is the guard the situation sheet asks for (push -0.0386) and the reason push_neg_x is measured at three seeds instead of one. tools/go2_screening_gate.py reads it under version post_a042_push_v1.
required_records.push_all_directions: REQUIRED RECORD AND PLAN SCREENING CRITERION (plan section 6). For push_pos_x, push_neg_x, push_pos_y and push_neg_y SEPARATELY: pooled posture falls over the three seeds must not rise above the baseline, and the per-seed median deltas of survival and tracking proxy must be >= 0. G-A043 guarded only the x directions and left y as a single-seed observation with no verdict; the full collection measures all four at three seeds, so the guard can now be as wide as the situation cell it guards (tools/go2_reward_mechanism.py PUSH_CASES is four directions). tools/go2_screening_gate.py reads it under version post_a043_push4_v1. This strengthens the bar and does not change G-A043's verdict, which was judged under post_a042_push_v1 and reproduces byte for byte.

The judgement that catches a loss there is the EXISTING max_flat_case_survival_drop of 0.0625, which already fired on G-A043's three seeds. No new judgement code is written for G2; what changes is that the case can no longer be missed by the collection or absent from the video set.

Its baseline sum is 4 robots over three seeds and its measured max_drop is 5.523, so its floor is -1.523 and no result can violate it. tools/go2_fact_rules.py calls that inoperable and raises it as a violation rather than passing it silently (defect S-2, 2026-09-19). hypothesis.statement: At lin_vel_z_l2 -1.0 the G3 and G6 gains observed at -1.5 and -1.25 (rough side-step posture falls, push falls) still appear; whether the G2 combined-turn posture cost appears is recorded. The 15 cm stairs are recorded, not judged.

rough_lateral_posture_falls.basis: the same line as G-A048's: 41 is about half-way between the baseline 59 and G-A043's 24. It is an operational criterion, not a statistical or official one, and it changes no adoption threshold.

yaw_right_posture_cost.basis: G-A043 fell at all three seeds (9, 9, 11); G-A033, G-A044, G-A047 and G-A048 at none. Read as occurrence on the candidate only; the baseline G-A033 had 0 at every seed. One seed only is INSUFFICIENT.

hypothesis.edge_rule: Avoiding falsification is not support: a value just inside a boundary (for example 58 rough side-step falls) is INSUFFICIENT, as the thresholds already say.
decisions: rough SUPPORTED, yaw cost ABSENT, adoption met: first promotion candidate on this dial; the seed replicate (branch A) is the next question.
rough SUPPORTED, yaw cost PRESENT: gain and cost observed together again (as at -1.5); record it, do not extend the range further.
rough NOT_SUPPORTED: the G3 gain did not hold at -1.0; this does not make -1.25 luck (a non-linear response explains it too). Stop extending this dial's range.
INSUFFICIENT on an indicator: no conclusion for that indicator; a clear worsening elsewhere is still used in the next decision.

any other mix (e.g. hypothesis supported but adoption failed on G4/G5/G7 or a flat guard): record per-indicator verdicts, re-compare the next candidates by the failed axis, do not collapse into one INCONCLUSIVE, do not rerun automatically.

stairs_15_ge2.basis: recorded, not judged: the penalty-share derivation behind 15 cm stairs does not hold across runs (base data section 5 S5) and 15 cm ge2 was 77 at -1.5 but 24 at -1.25. The count is kept for the next decision.

why: Purpose: see whether the G3 and G6 gains of the only dial that raised the total on this baseline hold one interval further. Not a promise of a higher score.

Role first (Isaac Lab formula): lin_vel_z_l2 pays -w * v_z^2 in the body frame, with no direction term, so the rise a tread requires is charged at the same rate as the bounce a bad landing produces. That is the mechanism this arm moves, and it is a property of the formula.

What is measured: at -2.0 / -1.75 / -1.5 / -1.25 the total was 42.53 / 38.89 / 44.62 / 50.16, rough side-step posture falls 59 / 80 / 24 / 16, push falls 22 / 66 / 10 / 1 and combined_yaw_right falls 0 / 0 / 29 / 0. Every counter is non-monotone across the four points.

Why -1.0: it keeps the 0.25 interval and steps once beyond the relaxed end. It is G-A037's held value, now chosen on the direct evidence of G-A043 and G-A048 and not on G-A037's penalty-share derivation, which still does not hold (S5).

Two verdicts, fixed before the run: the hypothesis indicators (rough side-step falls <= 41 supported / >= 59 not; combined_yaw_right falls at >= 2 seeds = cost present, 0 seeds = absent; 15 cm ge2 recorded only) and adoption under fact_rules_v1 plus post_a048_guard_margin_v1. Neither verdict rescues the other.

lin_vel_z_l2.role: Penalize z-axis base linear velocity using L2 squared kernel. [isaaclab_envs_mdp_rewards.py:76]
lin_vel_z_l2.out_of_range_reason: -1.0 is one 0.25 interval beyond the relaxed end of the four walking values (-2.0, -1.75, -1.5, -1.25). The run exists to extend the observed range; it is exploratory and its hypothesis thresholds are fixed before the run.

walk_margin.reason: Two situation cells are negative at -1.0 (sway, push) while climb and walk are positive - the same shape as -1.25 at a larger size. At -1.25 the sheet predicted losses on sway and all four push directions and every one came out a gain, so the cells are carried as a record. The losing axes are guarded anyway: rough as a scored group and a hypothesis indicator, all four push directions in the protection block, all filmed.

inference.rule: fact-based inference chain (2026-09-17 user instruction; MASTER section 5, AGENTS 4-9); a point-gain estimate is not required
inference.role: Isaac Lab v2.3.1 lin_vel_z_l2 (reports/evidence/go2_reward_term_roles_20260917/isaaclab_envs_mdp_rewards.py) pays -w * v_z^2 measured in the body frame. The square has no sign and the frame has no direction term, so rising onto a tread and bouncing after a bad landing are charged by the same expression; the weight is the only thing that separates how much either costs.

rows.reads: the relaxed end of the four measured walking values: total 42.52861 -> 50.15656, rough side-step posture falls 59 -> 16, push falls 22 -> 1, combined_yaw_right falls 0. With G-A043 it is the direct evidence that relaxing this dial moves G3 and G6 together on this baseline.
the other relaxed point: rough side-step posture falls 59 -> 24, push falls 22 -> 10, total 44.62454 - and in the same row the cost that G-A048 did not show: combined_yaw_right falls 29.
reward arithmetic at -1.0: walk margin +0.1359 -> +0.1601, zone WALK, range_status OUT_OF_RANGE. It rules out a standing policy by arithmetic and supports nothing else.

the frozen baseline this arm starts from carries this dial at -2.0, walks (POLICY_LOCOMOTES) and scores 42.52861/70 over 69 cases with terrain level 4.7087 at iteration 999. G-A043's harvest adds the second walking value of this dial and is not yet in this ledger file.

contradicting.reads: the midpoint was worse than both ends on the fall counters: rough side-step 59 -> 80, push 22 -> 66, total 42.52861 -> 38.89379. The fall response to this dial is non-monotone, so nothing predicts the falls at -1.0.
the total is non-monotone across the four measured values (42.5286 / 38.8938 / 44.6245 / 50.1566), as is every counter in the same file. No trend is extrapolated to -1.0.

contradicting.key: S5 오르기 수직 벌점 몫 대 15cm 오르기
contradicting.reads: the between-run test of the rule the original relaxation argument rested on. It still reports False, and it is the row that put G-A037 (-1.0) on hold. G-A043's stair result does not rescue that rule - it shows this weight moves the stairs on THIS baseline, not that the penalty share orders climbing across runs.
the situation arithmetic this spec carries at -1.0 (sway -0.0940) predicted a sway loss at -1.25 and the rough side-step proxy rose +0.411147. The -1.0 cells are a record, not evidence.

inference.singularity: One dial, four measured walking values on one baseline, every counter non-monotone: the total dips at -1.75 and rises at -1.5 and -1.25; the combined right-turn cost appeared only at -1.5 (0 / 0 / 29 / 0); 15 cm ge2 rose to 77 at -1.5 and fell to 24 at -1.25. Whether the G3 and G6 gains hold beyond -1.25 is unmeasured.

walk.basis: PROBES.csv at -1.0: walk margin +0.1359 -> +0.1601, zone WALK, about ten times the stop zone's top +0.0155. All four measured values walked. This rules out a standing policy and supports nothing else.

climb.basis: 15 cm ge2 was 0 / 0 / 77 / 24 across the four measured values and the penalty-share derivation does not hold (S5). No direction is claimed; the count is recorded, not judged.

sway.basis: the rough side-step fall counter was non-monotone (59 / 80 / 24 / 16) and the arithmetic cell got the direction wrong at -1.5 and -1.25. No direction is claimed; the hypothesis indicator reads it.

push.basis: four-direction push falls were non-monotone (22 / 66 / 10 / 1) and the arithmetic predicted losses at -1.25 that came out gains. No direction is claimed; all four directions stay in the protection block.

inference.falsified_if: Hypothesis (tools/go2_dial_hypothesis.py, thresholds fixed in preregistered.hypothesis): the G3 half is refuted if rough side-step posture falls are 59 or more; 42-58 is INSUFFICIENT, not near-support. The yaw cost is recorded, not refuted: present at two or more seeds with a posture fall, absent at none. The 15 cm count is recorded only. Adoption is separate: fact_rules_v1 plus post_a048_guard_margin_v1. A refuted hypothesis at -1.0 does not make G-A048's -1.25 result luck; it closes further range extension of this dial.
inference.seed_limit: Every training run used seed 42 and no seed replicate exists, so a result supports or refutes the exploratory hypothesis at this value on this path; it does not fix a lever effect (reports/GO2_SEED_SENSITIVITY.md section 5). The replicate is branch A of workspace/training/quadruped/upload/plan/GO2_NEXT_CANDIDATE_20260927.md, which waits on U2.
inference.status_reason: INFORMATION_RUN: -1.0 is outside the observed walking range, every counter of this dial is non-monotone across the four measured points, and the forecast sheet got five of eight directions backwards at -1.25. The run extends the observation range; it does not recommend a value.
inference.counterevidence_response: The adverse rows are carried, not footnoted: G-A044's non-monotone falls, the four-point non-monotonicity, the S5 row against the penalty-share derivation and the forecast sheet's wrong directions. The design responds by fixing hypothesis thresholds as counts before the run and keeping them separate from adoption, by recording the 15 cm count instead of judging it, by keeping every fact_rules_v1 threshold where G-A048 had it, by collecting all 69 cases in one pass, and by filming both combined-turn directions.
